title: General entry and scoring
text: BSc minimum entry is generally 80%, while technical and technician degrees generally use 70%. Competitive assessment may include high-school GPA, mathematics, physics, interview, introductory video, admission tests, and bonus points for documented extracurricular activities.

title: Engineering Tawjihi requirements

title: IGCSE engineering requirements
text: For the listed engineering BSc programmes, IGCSE requirements include grade B in mathematics, grade B in physics and 80% Tawjihi equivalency; permitted A-level/AS-level combinations are also specified.

title: IB engineering requirements
